notes.title: New Patch available now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33822842/d7b6a74cddd48fa618b1a6b55f6ae6475e7fdaa2.png[/img]

Due to popular demand, this patch introduces the most requested feature you’ve been asking for the past months!
We’re more than happy to give you the chance to race on your custom tracks while playing online with your friends!
Thanks to this new feature, you will be able to join your friend in a private lobby and race on one of the tracks you have marked as favorite!
Your favorite tracks will now have a new life since they not only have a dedicated tab while selecting a track but from now on those tracks will be the ones that you will be able to vote for a race with your friends!
Do you like a specific track that just a friend of you has marked as favorite? Do not worry! You will be able to vote it and race on it!
Together with the custom tracks online voting feature, we have fixed minor bugs in the Career Mode and the UI of the game.
What are you waiting for? Go and race with your friends on your favorite tracks!

notes.title: New week, new patch - 25-03
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33822842/be5220eee340679baeb418b3081552c811fe0766.png[/img]

New week, new patch incoming! This time, interesting improvements have been implemented, like the tear-off behaviour: when in helmet view, your goggles will now get dirty, and you’ll have to tear off the protective sleeve to see again. You’ll now also have more freedom of choice for your Multiplayer Games: choose categories from 450, 250 and from east or west coasts.
The online keep being our focus, more smoothness is to be expected thanks to fine-tuning to the vehicles replication in online matches. Along with all that, a series of fixes to improve graphics, online experience and UI! Let us know what you think! Here’s the full changelog:

Add Online category choice
Add tear off behaviour
Improved vehicles replication in online matches
Minor online fixes
Minor graphics fixes
Minor UI fixes

notes.title: New Patch released now - 19/03
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33822842/a587a4cdc27ab906dcfa9817e5174075daf08c86.png[/img]

A few days after our last appointment comes a new patch, completely dedicated to the community feedback.

Thanks to the reports you sent us we were able to replicate the game's bugs and solve them.

We are pleased to inform you that the bug on the "First Person View" has finally been fixed. Thank you all for the help you have given us.
Finally, the incorrect player name that appeared during the MEC in offline mode was fixed.

Fixed the problem of the camera in “the single event menu”, once entered in the rider’s selection.

Finally, thanks to the reports of some players, we noticed that before leaving the start at the start of a race, the track was immediately modified. The problem finally has been solved.

As the work for future updates proceeds (coming very soon), we leave you with the complete list of fixes for this patch:

Work on the next updates proceeds (coming very soon), in the meantime we leave you with the complete list of fixes for this patch:


	First Person View fixes
	Minor career fixes
	Minor online fixes
	Minor graphics fixes

notes.title: New patch available - 04/03/2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33822842/a62a62b4337bc37d9621a2559901282ae1c6ee7e.jpg[/img]

This patch is all about the community’s feedback, while adding one of your favorite features: the Online Championship.
With the Online Championship you’ll be able to organize a Championship in order to play with your friends. Gather some of your friends and let the race begin! Do you want to challenge your friends on the official tracks or you’re more into picking one of the best tracks made by the community? With the Online Championship you’ll be able to compete at your own rules!

After listening to your feedback, we’ve made some tweaks on the cornering and scrubbing in the game, in order to make them more responsive to your inputs. We’ve even slightly modified the game progression, so you’ll get more value from playing the game! And finally, we have unlocked the Red Plate for the 450 classes!

Talking about customization, we’ve modified the plate numbers so now they can become bigger than before, while the problems with plates, numbers and clothing items are now solved.
We’ve made some improvements with the track editor, as long as modules are concerned.
A fix pass on UI and in-game graphics have been made, with minor fixes implemented.

Here is the summary of the new patch

Add Online Championship
Tweaked physics for cornering and scrub maneuver
Increased credits earnings
Improved track editor modules
Tweaked plate number size customization
Fixed unlock inferno boots
Fixed unlock number 1 in rider customization
Fixed unlock Donald Braap trophy
Fixed red plate for 450 championship
Minor online fixes
Minor UI fixes
Minor graphic fixes

notes.title: Hotfix Patch now available - 26/02/19
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33822842/c8cd65af8efadfe136ac900ee2d7538a5ef766e2.png[/img]

Hey all, we're rolling out a hotfix to solve some crashes occurring in custom tracks. We'd also go a bit more in-depth in the online fixes on the last patch: Improved online in-game data replication: animations and player racing behaviors now are replicated in a more smooth and natural way. You will now see your opponents in a more fluid and precise way. Let us know how is this working for you.

notes.title: First Full Update available - 18/02/19
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33822842/81bed38f12099e528593a4c8849b25b6b1803f3b.jpg[/img]

We're so proud to announce that the efforts of our DEV team are finally taking concrete shape with the first full update. All your suggestions sent to our Customer Support and on our social channels have been gathered and are currently under scrutiny. We're working on most of them right now and we'll be able to address most of them in the patches to be released in the weeks to come. In the meanwhile, should you encounter bugs, or should you feel the need to share with us your suggestions, please do so through our Customer Support: http://milestone.it/supporto/?lang=en

But let's go a bit more in-depth on what you'll find in today's update:

With this patch we give the players the chance to create their own custom Championship, using the endless possibilities given by choosing custom tracks from the Track Editor. This will empower you, players, to create entirely custom competitions and everchanging events for your Championship that you will play with your friends.
ELO is now implemented in the game. With the ELO system, you’ll be now matched with people with a similar level of skill as yours so competition will be fairer.
We made small tweaks to the Track Editor in order to improve its usability, thus allowing to create your tracks more effectively.
Notification Center has received minor fixes to improve its usage and better convey information.
Minor changes to UI have been implemented as well. These changes will improve readability and the general appeal of certain UI aspects.
Minor online fixes have been made to improve the general online experience.

But we know some of you really can't do without a bullet-point so here it is:

• Added custom tracks available for custom Championship
• Added Elo support
• Improved Track Editor usability
• Improved Notification Center
• Minor online fixes
• Minor UI fixes
